title: The Crown of the Sundered Sea Anew
author: Edmund Brightwater
blurb: Yara Halloran, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
